_source: Wikipedia: 2026 United States Senate election in New Hampshire (primary Sept 8, 2026). Pappas won D primary 65%, John E. Sununu won R primary 68.5%. On-ballot losers in our DB: Scott Brown (R), Karishma Manzur (D). Withdrew list = seeded candidates never on the Sept 8 ballot: Shaheen retiring (open seat), Hassan not up until 2028 (seed error), Sullivan a former candidate for the seat, Innis/Lamare/Morse/Sivalingam early declared candidates no longer listed.
